label: def:braid-twist-flip
title: Braid involutions: twist and flip
html:
Let \mathbf{b}=(b_0,b_1,b_2) be the three branches of the cubic constraint — the sheets that the trefoil monodromy group S_3\cong D_3, the Galois group of the cubic, permutes. The two braid generators are the reflections twist \sigma_1=(b_0\,b_1) and flip \sigma_2=(b_1\,b_2), as 3\times 3 permutation matrices:

\sigma_1=\begin{pmatrix}
    0&1&0\\1&0&0\\0&0&1
  \end{pmatrix},\quad
  \sigma_2=\begin{pmatrix}
    1&0&0\\0&0&1\\0&1&0
  \end{pmatrix}.

Both are involutions (\sigma_1^2=\sigma_2^2=\mathrm{id}). They satisfy the braid relation \sigma_1\sigma_2\sigma_1=\sigma_2\sigma_1\sigma_2 — the defining relation of the trefoil-knot group B_3 — and their product is the order-3 rotation

  \alpha=\sigma_1\sigma_2,\qquad \alpha^3=\mathrm{id},

the cyclic permutation of the three branches; it is the \mathrm{SU}(2) generator \alpha of the \mathrm{SU}(2) generators. The dihedral relation \sigma_1\,\alpha\,\sigma_1=\alpha^{-1} exhibits D_3\cong S_3.

The four spectral resolvents w_1,\dots,w_4 carry this action through the conjugate pairs (w_1,w_4) and (w_2,w_3) and the projective ratios \eta_1=w_1/w_2, \eta_2=w_3/w_4 (the braid-group action): the reflection swaps the conjugate pairs, and the rotation cycles the three branches. The action lives on the branches rather than on the resolvents because S_3 has no faithful action on four points (4\nmid 6).
